build: The unmodified pinned CPU was compiled by the repository conformance recipe with GGML_CPU_GENERIC, -ffp-contract=off and one worker.
reference: Freeze the original dense scalar conversion inputs, results and refused input encodings from the integer-widths, integer-floats and octet-integers cases in crates/conformance/tests/contract.rs at 0eedb49. Use the pinned original GGML get_i32/set_i32 and get_f32/set_f32 routines and original E4M3 to_float/from_float_ref callbacks. The same words apply to the dense and padded layouts.
framing: Header gives pair count, lanes, layout count and graph-count flag. Each section gives GGML source, destination, invalid count and the permitted NaN infinity magnitude (zero for exact bits). Original input, reference and invalid words follow.
